line: Monday cuts a bit close today. Clear one big task by noon; the rest gets easier.
Your name comes up in a good way today. Be ready with a one-line update.
A fresh lead shows up today. Follow it up before the inbox buries it.
Set up the week's money plan today. Small, boring, works.
You're in a good mood today. Spread it around, and still hit the deadline.
You'll spot what's wrong in the plan today. Say it with a fix attached.
Your crowd is in sync today. Split the work fairly; nobody likes a solo hero.
Someone takes the good desk or the last seat today. Shrug and find a better corner.
Your gut has the answer today. Note it before the first meeting starts.
Help comes from someone senior today. Ask the question you think is too basic.
